summary: Iteration 34 — Full E2E test of THREE new Restaurants Galore features: (1) AES-GCM encrypted backups w/ passphrase, (2) auto-backup schedule persistence, (3) Smart Assistant chat history persistence. Backend pytest for /api/dining_insights (single-turn + multi-turn history + missing-stats 400) all pass. Frontend Playwright end-to-end verified: encryption-panel + encrypt-toggle + encrypt-passphrase, encrypted .rgenc download, plain .json download (backward compat), plain preview flow, .rgenc auto-routes to decrypt-panel (not preview), wrong passphrase toast, correct passphrase reveals preview, schedule-panel with interval/target/passphrase widgets (target correctly disabled when interval=off, enabled when weekly, schedule-passphrase visible only when weekly/monthly), localStorage rg_backup_schedule persists {interval:'weekly',target:'local',passphrase:'schedpass'}, Smart Assistant modal shows 'history is saved locally on this device only' copy, user/assistant bubbles render after send, messages persist across close+reopen (loaded from IndexedDB), Reset clears both UI and persisted history. Zero console errors during flow.

detailed_results.wrong_passphrase_error: PASS — 'Wrong passphrase or corrupted backup' toast shown
detailed_results.correct_passphrase_reveals_preview: PASS — backup-preview appears after decrypt-submit with 'test1234'
detailed_results.assistant_description_mentions_local_sto: PASS — 'history is saved locally on this device only'
detailed_results.assistant_persistence_across_reopen: PASS — 2 messages still shown after close/reopen (IndexedDB)

critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantWorkspacesP5.jsx — schedule passphrase is stored in plaintext in localStorage under 'rg_backup_schedule'. This is expected for a local offline app but worth documenting: anyone with device access can read it. Consider storing only a KDF-derived verifier or requiring re-entry per run.

restaurantsService.js — PBKDF2 iterations set to 200,000; adequate for 2026 but consider bumping to 600,000+ (OWASP 2023 guidance for SHA-256) for future-proofing, or exposing iterations as a config knob.

Auto-scheduled backup at boot (runScheduledBackupIfDue in NotesApp.jsx fetchData) — if the target is 'gdrive' or 'webdav' and network is unavailable/misconfigured on boot, ensure failures are swallowed silently so first-run UX isn't broken by a network toast. (Not tested here; source review only.)

Chat history in IndexedDB has no size cap visible in listChatHistory/appendChatMessage; a long-running user could accumulate thousands of turns. Consider trimming to last N (e.g. 200) messages on append.
Encrypted envelope shape {app, encrypted:true, kdf, iterations, salt, iv, ciphertext, meta} — good. Suggest adding a 'version' field so future format bumps can be detected cleanly.
seed_data_creation: none — persistence tests used fresh IndexedDB; encrypted backup exported with an empty dataset which is still a valid envelope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup entry: header-restaurants-galore → launcher-backup → backup-modal. Assistant entry: header-restaurants-galore → launcher-assistant → smart-assistant-modal. Encrypted file uses .rgenc extension and Web Crypto PBKDF2-SHA256 (200000 iters) + AES-256-GCM. To simulate schedule persistence, select schedule-interval=weekly (target auto-enables) — schedule-passphrase input then appears and rg_backup_schedule JSON writes on change. Chat history is stored in localforage store 'rg_chat_history' in IronRabbit DB. Assistant Reset button (data-testid=assistant-reset) clears both UI state and IndexedDB store. Playwright expect_download() works reliably for both .rgenc and .json exports. Full Restaurants Galore/NotesApp regression already validated in iter_33; this iteration focused on new features only.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All three new features (encrypted backups, scheduled backups, assistant persistence) work end-to-end.
